# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, report them through GitHub's private [Security Advisories](https://github.com/ranajahanzaib/career-transition-map/security/advisories/new) feature. Include a description of the issue, steps to reproduce, and its potential impact.

Please allow time for the maintainers to review the report. Do not include exploit details in a public issue or pull request.
